title: Baldy Land
overview:
Conquering the world depends on your strategy!

Skillfully control the Baldies and defeat your enemies!

Baldy Land is a real-time strategy game seen from above, where you watch over a tribe of little bald people and help their civilization grow while their hairy rivals, the Hairies, try to wipe them out.

The Baldies wander on their own, so you guide them with a giant hand that picks them up and drops them where they are needed. Placing a Baldy in a room of a house gives it a job: workers make energy to reshape the land, builders put up houses, barracks and laboratories, soldiers fight the Hairies, and scientists invent weapons and gadgets. New Baldies are born in a house's bedroom. Traps and hazards across the map can work for or against either side, and if every Baldy falls, the game is over.

- Four Baldy jobs: worker, builder, soldier and scientist
- Build up your village and invent new weapons
- Shuttle Mouse compatible, memory backup saves

世界征服は君の戦略次第！

ボールディをうまく操り、敵を倒そう！
